fullPassage: Training and competition naturally speed the breath, which activates the sympathetic nervous system. In performance, this is acceptable because an athlete wants to produce adrenaline and compete and train in an aroused state. However, it is equally important for an athlete to learn how to mentally and physically downshift from the acute sympathetic activity experienced in sport, and outside of performance focus their attention on slow breathing to reduce the sympathetic activity and resolve the fight-or-flight state. In the Feinstein Institutes study, participants were able to use the pace of their breathing to activate specific regions of the brain. In a performance realm, this means athletes can use breathing pace to manage their state of arousal. During training and competition, the breathing rate increases with the introduction of adrenaline, and athletes must be able to control this to be able to adapt and recover. One way is to practice slower breathing protocols outside of training and competition.

questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 downshift(줄이다/완화하다)가 들어가야 한다. 격렬한 교감 활동으로부터 정신적·신체적으로 속도를 줄여야 한다는 맥락.
det.analysis:
✅ downshift: 원문 일치 — 교감 활동에서 줄이다
❌ upshift: 반의어 — 올리다
❌ maintain: 유지 — 문맥과 반대
❌ intensify: 강화 — 반의어
det.tip: However 뒤 역접 → 흥분 상태에서 '줄여야' 한다는 흐름

det.analysis:

questions.passage: Training and competition naturally speed the breath, ① <u>which</u> activates the sympathetic nervous system. In performance, this is acceptable because an athlete wants to produce adrenaline and compete and train in an ② <u>aroused</u> state. However, it is equally important for an athlete ③ <u>learning</u> how to mentally and physically downshift from the acute sympathetic activity ④ <u>experienced</u> in sport.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ learning → to learn. 'it is important for A to V' 구문에서 to부정사가 필요.
det.analysis:
✅ ① which: 관계대명사 (계속적 용법) — 정상
✅ ② aroused: 과거분사 형용사 — 정상
❌ ③ learning → to learn: 'important for + 목적어 + to V' 구문
✅ ④ experienced: 과거분사 (뒤에서 수식) — 정상
det.tip: it is important for A to V — to부정사 구문

questions.passage: In the Feinstein Institutes study, participants were able to use the pace of their breathing to activate specific regions of the brain. In a performance realm, this ① <u>means</u> athletes can use breathing pace to manage their state of arousal. During training and competition, the breathing rate ② <u>increase</u> with the introduction of adrenaline, and athletes must be able to ③ <u>control</u> this to be able to adapt and ④ <u>recover</u>.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② increase → increases. 주어 'the breathing rate'는 3인칭 단수이므로 동사에 -s 필요.
det.analysis:
✅ ① means: 주어 this는 3인칭 단수 — 정상
❌ ② increase → increases: the breathing rate는 3인칭 단수, -s 필요
✅ ③ control: be able to + 동사원형 — 정상
✅ ④ recover: to adapt and recover — 병렬 구조 정상
det.tip: 주어-동사 수 일치: 3인칭 단수 주어 → 동사에 -s/-es
